0022600001.text: The Detroit Pistons host the Boston Celtics as both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, neither having played a game yet. Taurean Prince is listed as day-to-day for Detroit with a personal reason and is a game-time decision, while Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. In 2025-26 the Pistons won the season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 Pistons win in Detroit on January 19, 2026.
